description: Test file for the absl::base_internal::FastTypeId functionality, including tests for primitive types, fixed-width types, type aliases, template specializations, and inheritance relationships.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.PrimitiveTypes
methods.description: Test for type IDs of primitive types and their const, volatile, and const volatile variants.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.FixedWidthTypes
methods.description: Test for type IDs of fixed-width integer types and their variants.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.AliasTypes
methods.description: Test for type ID consistency with type aliases.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.TemplateSpecializations
methods.description: Test for type IDs of template specializations like vector and map.

methods.name: FastTypeIdTest.Inheritance
methods.description: Test for type ID differences between base and derived classes.
